rules.Strong: top third of the list by power = the budget left side x1 (2A + H + S, x the miss multiplier) from tools/skill_costs.js budget() at Level 1 at the card's home (first) list; the #1 is the map peak
rules.Cute: kind baby; a young animal by id (kit, pup, cub, calf, fawn, chick, duckling, hatchling, fry, sprout, grub ...); a small animal by id (shrew, mouse, chipmunk, vole, pika, rabbit, hare, hedgehog, squirrel, meerkat, robin ...); or, for a card first listed on Maps 0-5, the style guide's Cute genre (starter/common, Attack + Health under 15). Missing Cute flagged on Maps 0-5 only
rules.Resource: foraging, delivery, forestry, bounty, hoard, stonecutter, pickpocket, plunder, felling, pearl, onReadyGold, onSpawnGold, gainGold, or a trigger that gains a resource (Lumber ...)
rules.Support: nursing, healing, herbalist, cure, inspiring, repair, herald, fletcher, broodkeeper, venomMaster, packLeader, armourer, banner, warcry, or a trigger that shields / heals / buffs allies
rules.Ranged: any skill whose delivery is "ranged" in canonical/skill-delivery.json (arrows, bolts, Snipe, Twin Shot, Electricity, powders ...)
rules.Defender: guardian, taunt, armor, sturdy, shield, bulwark, helmet, fortify, shieldwall (Thorns not counted)
rules.Focus: the map's REDESIGN3 v2 focus skills shown at the card's base level (tools/redesign3/lib3.js metSkills); 2+ carriers wanted (Bloom, Meiosis: one allowed)
